Title: Vihaan's Day

Cast

1. Vihaan - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Shalini - 36 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Vinod - 36 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Riya - 13 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Shalini and Vinod stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Vihaan combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Vihaan (excited): "Okay, Dad."

[Vihaan irons his school shirt.]

Vihaan (laughing): "Mom, listen!"

[Vihaan does his homework at the table.]

Vihaan: "Mom, listen!"

[Vihaan's phone rings and he answers it.]

Vihaan (gently): "How beautiful!"

[Vihaan watches cartoons on TV.]

Shalini: "That was fun!"

[Vihaan slams the door shut.]

Vinod (gently): "Let's see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Riya stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Riya, look over here."

[Vihaan sings a song.]

Vihaan: "That was fun!"

[Vihaan claps his hands.]

Vihaan: "How beautiful!"

[Vihaan shakes his head.]

Shalini (excited): "Vihaan, are you okay?"

[Vihaan thinks for a moment.]

Shalini: "This is amazing!"

[Vihaan shouts angrily.]

Vihaan: "Yes, all right."

[Vihaan gives Mother a flower.]

Vihaan (happily): "Show me too!"

Scene 3: The garden - Day

Riya: "What a nice place."

[Vihaan waters the plants.]

Shalini (laughing): "Careful!"

[Vihaan chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Riya (happily): "What a day to remember!"
